claim: The INFO.SRC release ledger defines WHITE as the first release WITHOUT checksums.

source.verbatim: ROM1 THRU ROM12 ARE THE WHITE SOFTWARE (1ST RELEASE WITHOUT CHECKSUMS)

claim: The ledger defines the RED software as the cocktail release (ROM1C, ROM4E, and all other ROMXC), also released for upright ROM.

source.verbatim: ROM1C, ROM4E, AND ALL OTHER ROMXC ARE THE RED SOFTWARE (COCKTAIL SOFTWARE-

claim: The screen-flip data pair: WDATA $38 is the normal screen and $39 the flipped screen.
The player-2 switch tests the cocktail PIA bit (LDA PIA3, comment COCKTAIL?).
On cocktail, the code swaps in the upside-down IRQ handler (LDX #IRQB, SWITCH UPSIDE DOWN GUYS).
The flipped handler is headed INVERTED IRQ FOR SCREEN FLIP.
The resident block bakes in a checkbyte: FCB $4A, commented CKBYT CHECKSUM(ACTUAL) — checksums present, ruling out WHITE.
